title: The Whispering Forest
summary: The party enters the Blackbriar frontier, where a forgotten lantern is said to have warmed the land before the first winter of ruin.

title: Ashes of the Moor
summary: A ruined keep rises from a field of smoldering heather, where the cult’s first ash-mark is found beneath a collapsed bell tower.

title: The Shattered Tide
summary: A drowned chapel and black tide pull the party toward an enemy they cannot name, where sea sigils pulse beneath the moon.

title: The Iron Ridge
summary: The mountains answer with thunder and glacier-cold silence. Within the ruined fortress, a crown of stormsteel is hidden.

title: The Glass Marsh
summary: The marsh gleams like broken glass beneath the twilight, full of whispering reeds and old forbidden oaths.

title: The Vault of Echoes
summary: Beneath the ruins of a collapsed citadel, a chamber of listening stone stores every memory in a different bell tone.

title: The Hollow Crown
summary: A dead throne room opens beneath a frozen shrine, revealing the final living remnant of a kingdom that chose ritual over mercy.

title: First Dawn
summary: At the peak of the world, the signal of the first dawn waits under a temple of stars and the campaign’s final cost.
